news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro shares extend rebound, trading up over 8% intraday
news.summary: Multi-week bounce off post-Q2-earnings lows continues; consensus split Hold/Strong Buy, average price target roughly $25-29 versus a stock still well below its 52-week high near $30.

news.headline: Conway Capital Management discloses new $1.66M stake in ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: Q2 13F shows Conway Capital initiating a ~92,975-share position, part of a broader wave of institutional 13F filings reported in mid-August covering the quarter.

news.headline: MAK Capital discloses 7.8% passive stake in ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: MAK Capital reported 2,375,861 shares (7.8%), up from 6.3% in May, reinforcing it as one of the largest outside holders.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Q2 2026 earnings call: revenue miss framed as service-timing issue
news.summary: Management attributed the ~$1.8M Q2 shortfall to service timing rather than demand; opex +51%, cash $29.4M, and CAL facility now in hand as of July with first GLP statement of work signed.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro reports Q2 2026 revenue of $10.9M, cuts full-year guidance to $48-52M
news.summary: Q2 revenue +18% YoY but roughly $1.8M below consensus; shares fell over 15% after hours as guidance was cut from the prior $52-56M range.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro outlines five-pillar strategy targeting $500M in annual revenue
news.summary: Company cited 175+ active global centers, 60+ biopharma partners across 25+ active trials, and ~10 partner data readouts expected over the next 18 months.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Partner uniQure's planned BLA for AMT-130 (Huntington's disease), delivered via ClearPoint navigation and SmartFlow cannula; still on track per uniQure's Q3 2026 target as of this window with no confirmed submission yet.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Date not yet officially announced by the company; based on prior-year pattern (Q3 2025 was reported Nov 6, 2025). Will show whether the Q2 shortfall was timing-related.

catalysts.label: ~10 partner clinical trial data readouts
catalysts.detail: Biopharma partner readouts (e.g. AskBio, BlueRock, REGENXBIO, AviadoBio, PTC, Neurona, uniQure) using ClearPoint's delivery platform, out of 25+ active trials.

catalysts.label: First GLP IND-enabling study at ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories
catalysts.detail: Torrey Pines preclinical facility's first statement of work, expected to complete in 1H 2027 and help return the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment to growth.

pulse: Since the Aug 3 Q2 miss and guidance cut, no new company-authored press release has followed as of Aug 26 -- the only fresh developments are financing-flow signals (MAK Capital raising its stake to 7.8%, a small new Conway Capital 13F position) and a continued technical rebound in the shares off their post-earnings lows. The near-term story remains a wait for uniQure's Q3 2026 AMT-130 BLA filing as proof-of-platform-value, with ClearPoint's own Q3 earnings (expected early November, unconfirmed) the next hard data point on whether the Q2 shortfall was truly service-timing noise.
